item.name: Rainbow Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Rainbow mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Rainbow Master is the first Mutator Master goal, earned by pulling 5 Rainbow items from auctions.

item.name: Secret Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Secret auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Secret Master is a Mutator Master title for players who pull 10 Secret items from auctions.

item.name: Void Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Void mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Void Master tracks a larger mutation chase, requiring 25 Void items pulled from auctions.

item.name: Hologram Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Hologram mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Hologram Master is earned by pulling 50 Hologram items from auctions.

item.name: Chrome Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Chrome mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Chrome Master rewards players who pull 75 Chrome items from auctions.

item.name: Gem Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Gem mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Gem Master is a mutation-pull title for reaching 100 Gem items from auctions.

item.name: Diamond Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Diamond mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Diamond Master is earned by pulling 250 Diamond items from auctions.

item.name: Corrupted Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Corrupted mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Corrupted Master marks a deep mutation grind, requiring 500 Corrupted items from auctions.

item.name: Gold Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Gold mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Gold Master is a long mutation-pull target for players who pull 1000 Gold items from auctions.

item.name: Silver Master
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with Silver mutation auction finds.
item.cardSummary: Silver Master is the largest listed Mutator Master target, requiring 2000 Silver items from auctions.

item.name: Veteran
item.displayMeaning: Shows long-term time spent playing Storage Hunters.
item.cardSummary: Veteran is the first listed playtime title, unlocked by playing for 100 hours.

item.name: Master Veteran
item.displayMeaning: Shows a higher long-term playtime milestone.
item.cardSummary: Master Veteran is the larger playtime milestone, unlocked after 500 hours of play.

item.name: Three Star Master
item.requirement: Grade 100 items at the Three Star tier.
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with high-tier item grading.
item.cardSummary: Three Star Master is earned by grading 100 items at the Three Star tier.

item.name: Master Appraiser
item.displayMeaning: Shows broad item-grading progress.
item.cardSummary: Master Appraiser is a major grading title for grading 5000 items of any tier.

item.name: Auction King
item.displayMeaning: Shows long-term auction participation.
item.cardSummary: Auction King is earned by completing 1000 auctions.

item.name: Master Safecracker
item.displayMeaning: Shows progress with safecracking at the Locksmith.
item.cardSummary: Master Safecracker is earned by cracking 500 safes at the Locksmith.

item.name: Time Played
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.
item.displayMeaning: Shows how long you have been playing.
item.cardSummary: Time Played is a 50-Gem stat display that shows your playtime.

item.name: Auctions Played
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.
item.displayMeaning: Shows how many auctions you have entered.
item.cardSummary: Auctions Played is a 50-Gem stat display for showing auction participation.

item.name: Safes Unlocked
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.
item.displayMeaning: Shows how many safes you have cracked.
item.cardSummary: Safes Unlocked is a 50-Gem stat display for showing safecracking progress.

item.name: Items Graded
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.

item.cardSummary: Items Graded is a 50-Gem stat display for showing your item-grading total.

item.name: Items Repaired
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.
item.displayMeaning: Shows how many items you have repaired.
item.cardSummary: Items Repaired is a 50-Gem stat display for showing repaired-item progress.

item.name: Items Washed
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.
item.displayMeaning: Shows how many items you have washed.
item.cardSummary: Items Washed is a 50-Gem stat display for showing cleaned-item progress.

item.name: Items Sold
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.

item.cardSummary: Items Sold is a 50-Gem stat display for showing your sold-item total.

item.name: Energy Drinks
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.

item.cardSummary: Energy Drinks is a 50-Gem stat display for showing energy-drink purchases.

item.name: Vehicles Tuned
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.
item.displayMeaning: Shows how many times you have customized a vehicle.
item.cardSummary: Vehicles Tuned is a 50-Gem stat display for showing vehicle customization progress.

item.name: Net Worth
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.
item.displayMeaning: Shows your current net worth.
item.cardSummary: Net Worth is a 50-Gem stat display for showing your current net worth.

item.name: Luck
item.requirement: Buy this stat display for 50 Gems.

item.name: Millionaire
item.displayMeaning: Shows that you reached the one-million-cash milestone.
item.cardSummary: Millionaire is a vanity title for reaching 1,000,000 cash.
